actual_features: AABB packing, EXEC path, native backend, rotation disabled; four independent texture sets: 8192,8192,1024,2048 square
UNIV_OT_Check_Overlap completed for all four sets
Disposable two-layer mesh test confirmed the active new UV was packed and original UV retained
supporting_native_features: Average Islands Scale for leather density in the intermediate unwrap
Analytic thread tube UV: longitudinal arc length and circumference, independent end caps
overlap_scope: Within each texture set. Native edge warnings can include boundary/rounding contacts. Flagged triangles were refined against atlas triangles by positive-area clipping with 0.0001 pixel-square tolerance. Cross-island AABB overlaps also zero. This is not an exact zero-tolerance all-pairs proof.
preservation: Final four-set pass preserved all 14 targeted meshes vertex/edge/loop/face geometry hashes and existing UV layers relative to the intermediate unwrap. Earlier guide-authorized triangulation of selected Boolean/warped polygons preserved vertex positions and editable source. Material assignment was updated for the four texture sets; original snapshots retained.
limitations: UniV Normalize was tested on a disposable cube, but its near-zero-area tolerance skipped sub-millimetre product islands. Native Average Islands Scale was used in production. No blanket feature, paid backend, baking, painting, external application, animation, collision, or physics validation. BaseColor outputs are flat existing-material-color paint targets, not completed grain/fiber textures.
factory_extension_dependencies: Factory add-on loading may synchronize shared extension wheels against a reduced enabled list. Preserve saved enabled entries before loading required extensions. Dependencies affected during testing were restored from existing local wheel archives through Blender management; preferences file hash unchanged. No unrelated add-on registration or service calls.
